title: Scleroderma Treatment With Celution Processed ADRCs Registry
brief_summary: This registry study will assess the safety and performance of the Celution Device in the processing of an autologous graft consisting of adipose derived regenerative cells (ADRCs) in the treatment of hand scleroderma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of scleroderma and presence of hand scleroderma
* Cochin score ≥ 20 units

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body Mass Index \< 17 kg/m2
* Infection in any finger
* Stable medications for the treatment of scleroderma for ≥ 1 month
* Pregnant or lactating status.
study_population: Patients who are scheduled to receive or have received ADRCs prepared by Celution to treat hand scleroderma.
